name: ExtractLinkedInApplicants
label: Extract LinkedIn Applicants
description: Extracts LinkedIn applicants from a job posting, writes applicant data to Excel, downloads resumes, and moves files to a target folder.

fields.name: WebBrowserInstance
fields.label: Web Browser Instance
fields.description: Web browser instance used to navigate LinkedIn.

fields.name: JobPostingUrl
fields.label: Job Posting Url
fields.description: LinkedIn job posting applicants URL to process.

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: Excel worksheet where applicant details will be saved. Expected to have headers in same order: Applicant Name, Applicant Key, Applicant Url, Profile URL, Location, Email, Phone, Resume Saved Path, Resume Status, Processing Status, Processed At, Error Message, Page No, Applicant No.

fields.name: DestinationFolder
fields.label: Destination Folder
fields.description: Folder where downloaded resume files will be moved.

fields.name: RetryCount
fields.label: Retry Count
fields.description: Number of retries for transient applicant processing failures.

fields.name: TimeoutSeconds
fields.label: Timeout Seconds
fields.description: Maximum wait time for browser operations and downloads.

fields.name: ProcessedCount
fields.label: Processed Count
fields.description: Number of applicants processed in this run.

fields.name: SkippedCount
fields.label: Skipped Count
fields.description: Number of applicants skipped because they were already processed.

fields.name: FailedCount
fields.label: Failed Count
fields.description: Number of applicants that failed to process.

fields.name: LastProcessedKey
fields.label: Last Processed Key
fields.description: Last processed applicant key (normalized profile URL).
